items.docs:
Get Audience Insights for an ad account. The response will return insights for 3 types of audiences: the ad account's engaged audience on Pinterest, the ad account's total audience on Pinterest and Pinterest's total audience.

Learn more about Audience Insights.

info.name: Get audience insights scope and type

params.name: ad_account_id
params.description: Unique identifier of an ad account.

items.docs: Get the scope and type of available audiences, which along with a date, is an audience that has recently had an interaction (referred to here as a type) on pins. Interacted pins can belong to at least the most common **partner** or **Pinterest** scopes. This means that user interactions made on advertiser or partner pins will have the **partner** scope.
